facts.text: First-year applicants to engineering can receive Direct to College admission as Engineering Undeclared, ensuring placement into an engineering major after their first year.

sources.title: Direct to College Admission FAQs | UW College of Engineering
sources.quote: The Direct to College (DTC) admission process guarantees incoming first-year students access to an engineering major and provides a robust experience that facilitates exploration of our engineering disciplines.
